summary: Use Fractal names for repository script paths and Python helpers

schema.detail: Schema fixture bytes and wire formats are unchanged.

rules.detail: No admission, checkpoint or digest changes.

compatibility.detail: Installed soak unit and launchd identities, configuration paths and executable protocol values remain unchanged. Old soak, delivery-probe and Discord entry points exec their canonical Fractal sibling with the original interpreter style.

downtime.detail: No service restart is required by the repository path changes.

manual.detail: Source consumers use scripts/fractal-* and fractal_*.py. When copying an old-name bridge to an installation, copy its canonical sibling too; idle-soak also uses the canonical fractal-idle-sample. Existing service templates still invoke the installed old-name bridge because this repository has no installer that installs the canonical soak executable names.

recovery.detail: No persisted state changes; previous binaries remain compatible.
